components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA; indigo fill, h-11 for list/form actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, #5951BA); color: #fff; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #484295); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5951BA; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #5951BA 24%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E1E5EC); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #fff; color: var(--color-content, #172033); font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #C7CED9); background: var(--color-surface-muted, #F3F5F8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5951BA; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Settings Panel
components.description: White bordered panel for settings and form sections.
components.html:
Dati pagamento

Protocollo, scadenze e note F24.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #E1E5EC); border-radius: 0.875rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: none; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #172033; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #526077; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: h-11 field with strong border and indigo focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #172033; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; margin-top: 0.375rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #C7CED9); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #fff; color: #172033; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5951BA; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #5951BA 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-warning { background: color-mix(in oklab, #A15C07 10%, transparent); color: #A15C07; }

components.name: Info Alert
components.html:
Inizia dalla tua prima fattura

Crea un contatto e poi registra una fattura.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #175CD3 30%, transparent); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #175CD3 10%, transparent); color: #175CD3; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-alert-title { font-weight: 600; } .ds-alert-body { margin: 0; opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Navy structural shell with indigo active accent.
components.html: DocumentiOggi
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: #10213D; color: #F8FAFC; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; color: #AAB5C4; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #27345E; color: #F8FAFC; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #B9B3F0; }

narrative.overview:
Fatturino is an Operate-mode product UI: dense enough for daily fiscal work, calm enough to trust with real money and deadlines. Structure lives in cool navy and misty neutrals; indigo appears only when the user can act. Surfaces stay flat and bordered; elevation is reserved for overlays that interrupt the desk.

The system rejects decorative gradients, dark-mode chrome for the main canvas, and purple-on-white marketing tropes. Tailkit may inspire patterns, but the official kit is the Blade components under resources/views/components plus tokens in resources/css/fatturino.css.
keyCharacteristics: Light canvas with dark navy sidebar (structural, not interactive purple)
Indigo reserved for CTAs, focus, and active accents
Flat cards with hairline borders; shadows only on modals/elevated overlays
Outfit sans throughout; status color is semantic, never decorative
List shell pattern: page summary + raw table + mobile cards

rules.name: The Interaction-Only Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo is for interaction (CTA, focus, active accent). Do not paint large structural surfaces indigo.

rules.name: The Semantic Status Rule
rules.body: Green/amber/red/blue communicate state (paid, due, error, info). Never use them as brand decoration.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Stay on Outfit. Do not introduce a second display face for app chrome.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat. Shadows appear only for transient overlays (modals, elevated menus).

dos: Do use Blade kit components (x-button, x-alert, x-settings.panel, list-shell pieces) before inventing new chrome.
Do keep indigo rare and actionable; structure stays navy/mist/white.
Do keep list pages as summary + table + mobile cards.
Do preserve keyboard focus rings and Italian operational copy density.
Do treat Tailkit as inspiration only — no package, no catalog IDs in the repo.
donts: Don't paint the canvas or large cards indigo/purple.
Don't add resting drop shadows to cards or KPI strips.
Don't reintroduce Mary-era partials/*-actions or unused dashboard widgets.
Don't change routes, data, or business logic during UI work (PRODUCT constraint).
Don't invent a second typeface or dark-mode app shell.
